ITEM.PTXT: Full automatic air conditioner control is performed by the air conditioner computer installed in the instrument panel (below the air conditioning unit).

The air conditioning computer functions as one of the computers that make up the CAN communication system. In addition to receiving sensor and switch signals via dedicated lines, it receives signals necessary for air conditioning control from the engine control computer and meter computer via communication lines, enabling precise air conditioning control according to vehicle conditions. Similarly, the air conditioner computer also outputs air conditioning related signals to other computers via communication lines.

As a method of advanced air conditioning control matched to the occupants' sensations, automatic air conditioner control using a neural network has been adopted, enabling comfortable air conditioning.
By adopting a customize function using the diagnostic tool (TaSCAN), DTC output, various data output, etc. can be performed.
Panel diagnosis by operation and display on the air conditioner control section has been adopted.
CAN is an abbreviation for Controller Area Network, a serial communication conforming to ISO (International Organization for Standardization) standards.
